why_en: Consolidates scattered official post-processing chains into reusable recipes — describe the look, get the parameter combo, skip.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Three.js 生态，不碰 WebGL 原生或 Babylon.js。依赖 r150+ 的 EffectCo。
limit_en: Three.js only, not raw WebGL or Babylon. Requires r150+ EffectComposer API; older versions break. Provides snippets and wiring notes, not a full.
title_en: Post-processing only via EffectComposer chain, no material.
